- composite: Cells stellate/spiky with projections vs DMSO cobblestone epithelium, agrees with cell_solidity z -8.0. (agrees with measurements)
Microscopist's candidate mechanisms: Aurora kinase inhibitors (Frequent multinucleate cells with irregular lobed nuclei plus bright round tubulin-intense cells indicate mitotic failure/polyploidy with retained microtubules, classic for Aurora inhibition.)
Microscopist's uncertainty: Moderate: multinucleation and nuclear shape change are clear, but distinction between Aurora vs other mitotic failure (e.g. Eg5) from morphology alone is limited.

[Microscopist report on wells W4 (2 image field(s)), compared with a same-plate DMSO field] Cell density vs DMSO: lower.
- composite: Treated fields are sparse with large empty background vs near-confluent DMSO monolayer; no cell-count/density z-score was provided so this is not covered by measurements. (not covered by / disagrees with measurements)
- tubulin: Tubulin staining is on average brighter, with solid-white rounded cells and bright processes; agrees with tub_mean z=+7.3 (0.424 vs 0.246). (agrees with measurements)
- tubulin: Tubulin texture is coarse/high-contrast and clumped vs diffuse filamentous DMSO network; agrees with tub_glcm_contrast z=+42.5. (agrees with measurements)
- actin: Actin is more heterogeneous/high-contrast with bright peripheral rims and spiky protrusions vs flat DMSO lamellae; agrees with act_std z=+8.7 and act_glcm_contrast z=+14.8. (agrees with measurements)
- composite: Adherent cells are smaller and stellate/triangular with long thin extensions and jagged borders vs broad polygonal DMSO; agrees with cell_area z=-6.3 and cell_solidity z=-7.6. (agrees with measurements)
- dna: Nuclei are less solid/round, more elongated/irregular with occasional clustered nuclei in one cytoplasm; agrees with nuc_solidity z=-25.3 and nuc_form_factor z=-6.9. (agrees with measurements)
- composite: Increased proportion of small intensely yellow-white round cells suggestive of mitotic rounding/contraction; no mitotic-index measurement was provided so this is not covered by measurements. (not covered by / disagrees with measurements)
Microscopist's candidate mechanisms: Actin disruptors (small stellate-triangular arborized cells with reduced area/solidity, loss of broad lamellae, spiky peripheral actin rims and thin tubulin-filled processes plus contracted bright round cells); Microtubule stabilizers (markedly brighter clumped/high-contrast tubulin with intensely stained round cells and examples of multiple nuclei in shared cytoplasm suggesting bundling/mitotic failure; cannot exclude from tubulin changes alone)
Microscopist's uncertainty: Moderate: strong cytoskeletal phenotype affects both actin and tubulin and overlaps stabilizer vs disruptor patterns; single concentration/timepoint with 103 cells limits distinction of primary target and of mitotic vs apoptotic rounding.
